messages:
Maria: quick heads-up 1: mixnet bring-up eval CI failing on runner sharding. 11/16 shards erroring with duplicate prompt ids.

Ajay: saw that. logs point to overlapping shard boundaries. example from CI:
```
[2025-11-02T02:14:36Z] shard=5 start=12500 end=15000
[2025-11-02T02:14:36Z] shard=6 start=14999 end=17500
AssertionError: duplicate prompt id 14999 found in both shards
```

Dinesh: suspect source is synthgen manifests. We regenerated splits with --split seeded-latest but forgot to pass --seed; when synthgen was run in parallel it sometimes emitted duplicate ids.

Jen: short-term: add a leakage preflight to eval harness that fails fast when any prompt id shows up in more than one split. cheap and quick.

Sam: runner bug too. current code computes end as int((i+1)/num_shards * n) which relies on float truncation and can overlap. change to integer arithmetic: start = (i * n) // num_shards; end = ((i+1) * n) // num_shards. deterministic and covers edge cases.

Ajay: i'll do a tiny PR with that fix and add unit tests enumerating many n/shard combos, including odd n and non-power-of-two shard counts. tests: test_shard_no_overlap and test_shard_full_coverage.

Maria: also, pin the dataset manifest in CI jobs instead of using latest. for this bring-up use prompts@v2.4.1 which matches our offline eval baseline.

Dinesh: i'll wire a CI step check-split-leakage that runs before runtime test. plan:
```
python - <<PY
import json
M=json.load(open('manifest.json'))
ids=[x for s in M['splits'] for x in s['ids']]
if len(ids)!=len(set(ids)):
    raise SystemExit('leakage detected')
PY
```
and artifact the splits to s3://redwood-eval/artifacts/splits/${CI_RUN_ID}/ for postmortem.

Jen: add a fixture file tests/fixtures/synth_manifest_seeded.json and a smoke test test_synth_reproducible that runs synthgen --seed 42 and diffs against the fixture. prevents future silent regen issues.

Sam: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/ev/PR-922 (runner math + tests + small linter rule).

CI Bot: failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/ev-harness/1754308876 10: failing test_shard_no_overlap

Maria: reviewing PR now. once merged we should re-run the mixnet eval pinned at prompts@v2.4.1. if timing is tight, schedule an overnight run.

Ajay: note for tests: generate random n in [1..10000] and shard counts in [1..16] to cover weird boundaries. also add a property-based check for contiguous coverage.

Dinesh: will add the split artifact upload and a small helper script to compute split diffs for debugging.

Jen: tiny enhancement: make the leakage check output a short sample of conflicting ids and which splits they appear in, so triage is faster.

Maria: perfect. assign owners: Ajay for runner fix/tests, Dinesh for CI wiring/artifacts, Jen for fixtures/smoke, Sam for merge coordination. aiming to land today so bring-up runs tomorrow. :thumbsup:
